title: Kth largest element
statement_markdown: Given an integer array `nums` and an integer `k`, return the `k`th largest element in the array. Note that it is the `k`th largest element in the sorted order, not the `k`th distinct element.

hints: Use a min-heap of size k.
explanation: Maintain a min-heap of size `k`. Iterate through the array, pushing elements onto the heap. If the heap size exceeds `k`, pop the smallest element. The root of the heap will be the kth largest element.
complexity: O(n log k) time and O(k) space.
